## What

A successful same-owner managed carry can remove a hook that was correctly repaired on disk. The CLI child is replaced, but its long-lived PTY host keeps the regeneration route and loaded launcher code. If that route uses an older operator writer, the next home can lose newer enrollment before the new child starts.

EI-28868085715949066 measured this on ADV61888. The19:28:07.505Z canonical repair produced hooks SHA256 `4e90ab28da77794f52cd3475b75ff6729d41ab1a911e90b53e01bae624187402` with two UserPromptSubmit entries: provenance plus injection. Immediately before generation5/native `01a1e14d-b73d-7ce1-8e59-fe37d8be4f33`, the file mtime became22:21:59.850981Z and its hash reverted to the exact original `03b5bc431803ab68284cdfe555c20373fac11b036447ff0e96b1cc86736009fa`, with injection only. New native tool execution did not prove the missing hook ran.

## Why it matters

Enrollment, runtime replacement and actual owner capture are separate claims. Repeating repair then carry can cycle forever when carry rewrites the repair. A missing capture receipt must never be repaired by inventing hook provenance or treating an agent-recorded transcript as captured owner authority.

The current canonical role-codex-home writer enrolls the provenance script; the inspected release writer did not. The live child environment pinned operator routing to127.0.0.1:9071, whose unselected home-repair request follows the stable target. The pre-carry helper accepted `ok:true` without checking the resulting managed enrollment. The exact upstream request trace was not retained; route configuration is evidence of the selected path, not a per-request serving receipt.

## How to apply

1. Preserve owner, ADV, current native UUID/generation, launch profile and checkpoint references. Read the actual hook file after regeneration, not only the operator response.
2. Reuse `codexManagedTurnHookReadiness` in psu-launcher.mjs. Ordinary canonical home repair now rejects incomplete post-repair provenance or synchronous journal enrollment with stage `home-hooks` and reason `managed-turn-enrollment-incomplete`. It reuses the same installed-host scope, owner binding, Codex client and ledger pin as initial readiness. It does not hand-edit missing commands or alter native history. Exact preserved-artifact replay retains its separate receipt contract.
3. An already-running parent does not adopt a source edit merely because its child carries. Before another carry, establish that its regeneration route uses the current writer. If the old stable writer must remain, prepare a maintained same-owner host successor on the current operator: preserve checkpoints/profile; have the responsible custodian retire the old host through `fleet:kill`; verify it ended; then use `capability:launch-agent` with `successor:{agentId:<same-owner>}` and `mcpTarget:'spawn-host'` from the verified current-build operator. Preserve visibility, model/effort, account, fleet, modes and carry settings. Never launch a successor over a live predecessor or use raw signals. The live schema accepts `stable` and `spawn-host`, not `staging`.
4. The spawn-host route binds bootstrap/MCP and `PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_URL` to that operator. Verify the actual spawned route and post-generation hook hash, then verify real native pickup and machine-origin provenance. Admission alone is insufficient.
5. Accept capture only after a naturally occurring genuine owner turn has its intact text, current native session/turn and matching server `captured_by_hook` receipt. A status question is not retirement authorization. No repeat retirement input should be requested while capture is still broken.

## Evidence and verification

The native digests are `.papercusp/scratch/bash-3f1c8587-460.log` and `bash-018f9ac5-0ff.log`; routing digest is `bash-28b0b87a-7a0.log`. Complete evidence and limitations are retained on EI-28868085715949066. Controlled ledger reads used directive3154 only as a known-positive read control, never as new authority.

The maintained launcher suite reproduced four false successes before the guard (test run23898098: four failed,109 unselected). After the guard, run23898104 passed113 tests with zero skips, including missing provenance, wrong client, wrong ledger and missing journal during successful regeneration. Native history preservation and existing canonical repair success also passed. Full current log: `/tmp/ei-288680-carry-home-guard-green.log`. These are source-boundary regressions; a genuine post-fix live owner capture remains a separate acceptance prerequisite.
